final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS a FROM film GROUP BY rating), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.rating AS rating, s1.a AS a, s1.a - s2.m AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.a > s2.m), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.rating AS rating, s3.a AS a, s3.d AS d, s3.a - s4.m AS e FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.a > s4.m) SELECT AVG(a), AVG(d), AVG(e) FROM s5
